Corollary
[higher-order Schauder estimates]

Source: petersen:page-0422 ↗ thm:pet-ch11-schauder-estimates 1. ch11:11.2.3When $\| a^{ij}\| _{C^{m,\alpha }},\| b^i\| _{C^{m,\alpha }}\le \lambda ^{-1}$, one has $C=C(n,m,\alpha ,\lambda ,\delta ,D)$ with \[ \| u\| _{C^{m+2,\alpha },K}\le C\big(\| Lu\| _{C^{m,\alpha },\Omega }+\| u\| _{C^0,\Omega }\big), \] and on a domain with smooth boundary, $\| u\| _{C^{m+2,\alpha },\Omega }\le C\big(\| Lu\| _{C^{m,\alpha },\Omega }+\| \varphi \| _{C^{m+2,\alpha },\partial \Omega }\big)$.
